shellCommands.command: git diff && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version"
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; ls 01-app/02-guides | grep -i -E "cache|migrat|instant"; grep -rn -i "opt out\|opting out\|unstable_instant\|instant = " 01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md | head -30; grep -rln "connection()" 01-app | head

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for i in 1 2; do curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Operations</nav>\|Loading request details…\|Request [^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*\|<aside[^>]*>[^<]*\(<!-- -->[^<]*\)*' | head -5; echo ---; done; pkill -f "next start" ; grep -rn "instant\|dynamic =" app components; git status --short
grep -rn "instant\|dynamic =" app components; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
